name: Aganskaya-Vertikos Gas Pipeline (KS Aganskaya-KS Aleksandrovskaya/Vertikos; Nizhnevartovsk GPZ-Parabel-Kuzbass capacity expansion)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Nizhnevartovsk GPZ-Parabel-Kuzbass capacity expansion; Eastern Gas Supply System (VSG) Aganskaya-Volodino section
values.EndLocation: Aleksandrovskaya Compressor Station / Vertikos Compressor Station

researcher_notes: Matched-to-existing re-check: not P2350/P7615 (existing I/II lines, Nizhnevartovsk-Parabel-Kuzbass), not P7612 (Myldzhino-Vertikos 110 km), not P0734 PS-2 (roster row has no Aganskaya endpoints; 2700 km Urengoy-Mongolia/China export route). Neftegaz places the Aganskaya-Aleksandrovskaya stretch inside Gazprom's Eastern Gas Supply System (VSG) as the KS Aganskaya (KS-9)-KS Volodino section, linking existing trunks to supply Altai/Kemerovo/Novosibirsk/Tomsk; VSG's Volodino-onward leg (PS-2 west-route link, cf. P6535 Volodino-Krasnoyarsk) is a separate later section, so this is a distinct new domestic capacity line, not a PS-2 section as such (P0734 parent linkage to be noted by reviewer). Sources: Tomsk vice-governor reply to RIA Tomsk (2025-06-23): Gazprom implementing KS Aganskaya (KhMAO) - KS Vertikos (north Tomsk) project, >400 km, target 2029, raises Nizhnevartovsk GPZ-Parabel-Kuzbass capacity. Interfax 2025-04-22 / Neftegaz 2025-04: Gazprom board-level presentation; laser scanning done, engineering surveys being completed for Aganskaya-Aleksandrovskaya. Threshold: sponsor Gazprom yes; endpoints yes; concrete step = engineering surveys near complete + board review + 2029 target in regional-government reply (no tender/FID/permit yet, so borderline; accepted as pre-design step). Length >400 km is a lower bound from a regional-government statement (LengthKnown=400 recorded as floor); Aleksandrovskaya vs Vertikos endpoint naming differs between sources (possibly same node region, unresolved). Capacity, diameter, cost not found. Tier medium: two independent-ish publishers (Interfax=Gazprom release, RIA Tomsk=regional govt), length approximate. Route: none found.
